title: Installment Delivery Metrics
description: Delivery metrics for one canonically identified installment.

installment_name.description: Current human-readable installment name. Convenience metadata only; installment_ref is stable identity.

scheduled_at.description: Convenience echo of the installment's scheduled publication or air time. A postponed installment keeps its installment_ref and gets a new scheduled_at.

installment_status.description: Lifecycle status of this installment. Absent means a delivery row, as in AdCP 3.2. A cancelled row carries no delivery metrics: it omits impressions, and spend reflects only what the accepted terms bill. A seller that declares cancelled in available_installment_statuses MUST report a sold installment that will not run as cancelled rather than drop the row. Metrics on a scheduled or tentative row are expectations, not delivery. Sellers MUST NOT send rows with scheduled, tentative, postponed, or cancelled to callers pinned below AdCP 3.3; a caller with no declared pin counts as below 3.3.

publication.description: Proof the installment was published. Seller-reported evidence, not by itself a billing event: billing follows the accepted terms. Sellers SHOULD populate it for a digital installment (creator post, newsletter edition, podcast episode) reported as published. MUST be absent when installment_status is scheduled, tentative, postponed, cancelled, or live.
